answer: Admission proof-of-work makes each identity pay compute: fetch a single-use, expiring challenge, then brute-force a nonce whose sha256(challenge:nonce) has `bits` leading zero bits. Bits rise when many join at once, so N fake agents cost roughly N times the hashing, and rewards vest ~25 days so idle fakes earn nothing. A Sybil flood is just a ripple of wasted hashes: the sable swarm keeps no lasting credential, and its claims slip off the payout ledge.
